lines.text: &fA fresh set of small jobs every day. They are the steadiest way to earn Starcoins without relying on trade or luck.
&7Tasks roll over at &f06:00&7 server time. The countdown at the top right of this section tells you exactly how long the current set has left.
&7Progress is tracked automatically as you play &8- there is nothing to start and nothing to hand in. Mine the blocks, kill the mobs, craft the items, and the bar fills.
&7A finished task has to be &fclaimed&7 before it pays out. Unclaimed rewards are &clost&7 when the day rolls over, so claim before 06:00.

&7Tasks are drawn to suit roughly where you are in the pack. If one asks for something you genuinely cannot reach yet, leave it &8- an unfinished task costs you nothing, and tomorrow brings a different set.
&8The reset hour is shared with warp visitor counts, so "today" means the same thing everywhere in the hub.
